# Build trees are not the port's source; a game's hand C is the game's C on its way into games/
# (docs/LAYOUT.md), not host code. The tests that include hand C are still read.
# The modules (CODING_CONVENTIONS.md, section 9.1). enhanced/tests/ holds test programs, so it is
# read as tests; enhanced/tools/ (the probe baker) stays with enhanced, whose code it drives.
# The layers, lowest first. sdk is the mod SDK's C ABI (sdk/include/openrac), a contract that
# depends on nothing. game/common is the host program; viewer, extract, tools (hostgen's harness),
# android (the app's glue) and tests are the programs.
# Edges within a layer. audio plays the sound formats assets reads; media's movies carry PSS audio
# that assets decodes. The world renderers and the Vulkan backend build on renderer's GL-shaped
# interface, and the Vulkan backend carries out the world renderers' GL calls too (gl_world.h).
# The tests cover the programs' code.
